googleAi.note: Search foundation and original user value; no special GEO shortcut

googleContent.note: AI-assisted content still needs original value and factual review

googleGen.note: Owner-native Google generative AI exposure reporting

googleMulti.note: New September 24 multimodal Search Console filter and export

bingAi.note: Sampled provider-native citations/queries; not traffic or causal impact

bingNew.note: Preview Intents, Topics, query-scoped Citation Share and comparison

webmcpEval.note: Task-level stochastic agent evaluations for WebMCP

webmcpSecurity.note: Tool authorization, untrusted output, consent and origin boundaries

webmcpTrial.note: Chrome-origin-trial status; not a universal interoperable Search switch

paperGeo.note: Critical survey of GEO evidence limits and stochastic multi-stage visibility

paperRag.note: Corpus/embedder/judge robustness in RAG requirements traceability

paperAttribution.note: Compression versus source-span attribution, with evaluator limitations

googleControl.note: Publisher control is a decision; do not silently change owner preferences

opportunities.insight: Verify each generated factual claim against the actual original cited passage, not against an intermediate AI summary.
opportunities.existingFirstAction: Use existing reference and editorial-receipt evidence; create a frozen, human-reviewed 20-question pilot, not a new publication surface.
opportunities.verification: Report supported/unsupported/ambiguous claims and source mismatch separately; keep source locations and missing evidence.
opportunities.stopCondition: Stop if passages or publication rights are not accessible; a model judge alone is not ground truth.

opportunities.insight: Test whether a discovery or recommendation observation survives neutral paraphrases, reruns, language, and model-surface drift.
opportunities.existingFirstAction: Extend the existing frozen query/prompt panel with a separately versioned secondary robustness panel; do not retroactively edit Ptichi r2.
opportunities.verification: Preserve exact prompts, answer artifacts, query families, repetitions, dates, models and mention/citation/recommendation distinctions.
opportunities.stopCondition: Do not pool different engines, post-selected winning prompts or missing runs into one visibility score.

opportunities.insight: The next deliverable is one justified owner decision, not an extra protocol, graph, dashboard or count of researched ideas.
opportunities.existingFirstAction: Use Roadmap M1 and issue #148; select a currently blocked, unchanged or low-risk intervention with a real evidence source.
opportunities.verification: Record next action/no-op/unknown and how the evidence changed the decision versus generic advice.
opportunities.stopCondition: Stop new feature development when no real owner case demonstrates a decision advantage.

opportunities.insight: Audit whether shared navigation, templates, links and later source edits contaminate frozen treatment and control groups.
opportunities.existingFirstAction: Reuse source-drift and treatment-cohort integrity checks from PR #151 on the next actual review window.
opportunities.verification: Classify unchanged, exposed-to-shared-change, uncertain, or incompatible controls before interpreting outcomes.
opportunities.stopCondition: Do not repair a contaminated cohort by rewriting its historical freeze.

opportunities.insight: Review headings, summaries, alt text, social previews and structured data as claims that must match the underlying page.
opportunities.existingFirstAction: Extend existing editorial parity and original-evidence workflow to a small sampled page cohort; no automatic mass rewrite.
opportunities.verification: A human can point to each concrete fact; no empty brand promises, fabricated expertise, or title/body contradictions.
opportunities.stopCondition: Do not replace human writing with generic AI-polished claims or publish thin query variants.

opportunities.insight: Google introduced a multimodal Search Console filter on September 24, 2026: useful only where real visual-query observations exist.
opportunities.existingFirstAction: Add an optional read-only owner review step for real Lens/Circle-to-Search and multimodal generative Search observations.
opportunities.verification: Keep web, generative-AI and multimodal scopes and export dates explicit, including unavailable/zero-volume cases.
opportunities.stopCondition: No images, schema, or tools should be added merely to populate a newly released report.

opportunities.insight: Map actual Bing grouped grounding phrases and intent/topic labels to their cited canonical pages before suggesting fresh URLs.
opportunities.existingFirstAction: Reuse existing arwp-bing owner context and query-page mapping without treating sampled phrases as literal user prompts.
opportunities.verification: Review one page per supported intent gap; cite the actual provider filter and observation window.
opportunities.stopCondition: Skip when Bing data are unavailable or sparse; Citation Share is neither ranking nor clicks.

opportunities.insight: Test a human-authored answer improvement with a concise original example, reproducible artifact or practical exercise.
opportunities.existingFirstAction: Use existing canonical page and deployment receipt; change one substantive answer, not an entire topic cluster.
opportunities.verification: Compare factual clarity and user task success first, then owner-side results in compatible windows.
opportunities.stopCondition: Do not make an unmeasured publication count or claim ranking improvement.

opportunities.insight: Measure whether an agent selects the right real tool for a real task and succeeds through a whole journey.
opportunities.existingFirstAction: Use the existing agent-eval tooling on a read-only sandbox; compare semantic HTML baseline with an optional WebMCP prototype.
opportunities.verification: Freeze tasks, success rubric, initial state, retries and tool-call trace; include mid-chain failures.
opportunities.stopCondition: Do not publish WebMCP as a universal browser feature or SEO ranking signal.

opportunities.insight: Test prompt-injected tool descriptions, cross-origin requests and malicious retrieved output before adding any agent actions.
opportunities.existingFirstAction: Create adversarial fixtures for read-only demonstration; require explicit authorization for irreversible/write operations.
opportunities.verification: All off-origin, untrusted-output and unauthorized writes must fail safely; record declined calls.
opportunities.stopCondition: Skip production tool exposure without confirmed hosting, session boundaries and owner consent.

opportunities.insight: Compare retrieval systems while varying corpus split, embedding method and judge; report strata not one pooled winner.
opportunities.existingFirstAction: Run a small held-out fixed question set against existing BM25/simple retrieval and any proposed semantic/graph variant.
opportunities.verification: Record retrieval hit, answer fidelity, source-span support and evaluator agreement independently.
opportunities.stopCondition: Do not replace working BM25 on evidence from one corpus or one LLM judge.

opportunities.insight: Compare shorter extractive evidence context against abstractive summaries under equal token budgets.
opportunities.existingFirstAction: On the same frozen questions, compare evidence-bearing spans and answer support before and after compression.
opportunities.verification: Report exact source matches and token cost; record abstentions and losses.
opportunities.stopCondition: Reject compression that makes answers read well but breaks original-source attribution.

opportunities.insight: Compare task correctness and evidence fidelity across supported languages without assuming translated prompts are equivalent demand.
opportunities.existingFirstAction: Freeze matched intent families and native-language editorial review; split by locale and audience.
opportunities.verification: Track supported claims, task success, bad translations and coverage gaps separately.
opportunities.stopCondition: No automatic multilingual programmatic pages to inflate indexable URLs.

opportunities.insight: Classify failed tasks by incorrect selection, bad retrieval, missing evidence, execution failure or evaluation ambiguity.
opportunities.existingFirstAction: Map to existing Search Failure Doctor, Resolver regret and agent-eval receipts instead of creating an opaque success score.
opportunities.verification: An owner gets one corrective action at the first evidenced broken stage.
opportunities.stopCondition: Do not promote a guessed root cause from a single incomplete observation.

opportunities.insight: Prevent cherry-picked AI-answer screenshots by scheduling fixed-panel repeated samples and preserving missed runs.
opportunities.existingFirstAction: Use current Controlled Cohort timeline and a supplemental prompt-panel log only when outcome access exists.
opportunities.verification: Keep chronological coverage, stable families, provider changes, controls and non-results.
opportunities.stopCondition: Do not fabricate exact prompts from Bing grouped grounding queries.

opportunities.insight: Explicitly recommend doing nothing where there is no evidence-backed next move, instead of scoring every site red.
opportunities.existingFirstAction: Reuse existing one-action Search Failure Doctor and documented no-op/unknown paths.
opportunities.verification: A reviewed case states the actual missing evidence, the user goal and exactly what observation would reverse the no-op decision.
opportunities.stopCondition: Do not turn absence of provider data into a negative metric or a synthetic uplift estimate.

opportunities.insight: Watch the cost of retries and CI fan-out per accepted decision rather than minimizing model tokens in isolation.
opportunities.existingFirstAction: Reuse issue #150; audit PR workflow and agent loop duplication with actual run histories, no assumed billing charges.
opportunities.verification: Record run count, reviewer time, rework and unique verification coverage before/after.
opportunities.stopCondition: Never disable essential checks or block security gates to improve apparent cost.

opportunities.insight: Make a portable card that says owner question, exact source, what already exists, one test, acceptance and rollback.
opportunities.existingFirstAction: Reuse existing experiment/receipt contracts and this research set; link to existing issues before making new ones.
opportunities.verification: A second project can reproduce the method without inventing an independent state machine.
opportunities.stopCondition: Do not roll out target-repository changes without separate authorization.

opportunities.insight: Chrome 149 origin-trial APIs are suitable for task-oriented pilots, not for automatic Search optimization.
opportunities.existingFirstAction: Watch stable rollout and cross-browser compatibility; prototype only with true user-visible read-only capabilities.
opportunities.verification: Show task-completion difference against native HTML controls, plus security negative cases.
opportunities.stopCondition: No agent-facing mutating tool may infer permission from metadata.

opportunities.insight: Google Search Console now offers a generative-AI content inclusion control; this is a rights/business decision, not an optimizer toggle.
opportunities.existingFirstAction: Document where an authorized owner checks it, keeping crawler training controls separate from Search inclusion.
opportunities.verification: Record the owner's intentional preference and observed report scope; never infer state from repository code.
opportunities.stopCondition: Never silently switch owner preferences or promise ranking changes.
